words.sense: moderate and restrained, especially in eating and drinking; taking only what is needed and avoiding excess
misconceptions: thinking it means 'not eating at all'

words.sense: refraining entirely rather than consuming in moderation
misconceptions: thinking it only applies to religion

semantic_axes.description: the degree of consumption, ranging from moderate/measured to zero

edges.boundary_rule: When someone is abstemious, they consume in limited, moderate amounts, whereas when someone is abstinent, they consume nothing at all.

misconceptions.M1: thinking any limit equals total refraining
misconceptions.M2: thinking total refraining is just a very strict form of moderation
misconceptions.M3: forgetting that one small amount makes A correct

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Sarah manages her dessert portions?

beats.text: Sarah keeps her portions small, never taking more than a single, measured slice of cake even when others are having seconds.
beats.reason: She is consuming, but doing so with restraint.

beats.text: She occasionally enjoys a tiny piece of chocolate to satisfy her craving, always ensuring she stops right after.

chains.feedback_short: Sarah is clearly consuming, just in small amounts, not avoiding entirely.
chains.feedback_deep: Being abstemious is about consuming in moderation. Because Sarah still eats small, measured amounts, she is not abstinent.
chains.contrast_rule: Abstemious allows small, controlled amounts; abstinent allows none.

hints.axis: the degree of consumption, ranging from moderate/measured to zero
hints.contrast: Abstemious allows small, controlled amounts; abstinent allows none.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Ken's choice regarding alcoholic drinks at the party?

beats.text: Ken has decided he will not have even a single drop of alcohol at the celebration.
When friends offer him a champagne toast, he politely declines, reiterating his commitment to zero intake.

chains.feedback_short: Ken is avoiding alcohol entirely, not just moderating his intake.
chains.feedback_deep: Abstinent means refraining entirely. Since Ken refuses all alcohol, he is abstinent, not abstemious.
chains.contrast_rule: Abstemious allows moderation; abstinent requires total refraining.

hints.attention: Does he drink even a little bit?
hints.axis: the degree of consumption, ranging from moderate/measured to zero
hints.contrast: Abstemious allows moderation; abstinent requires total refraining.
